plan.name: v1.9.3-bridge-fee-burn
plan.info: Burn bridge fees and store attestors separately

title: Upgrade: v1.9.3-bridge-fee-burn
summary:
This upgrade burns bridge fees and stores mint attestors in separate KV entries so attestation records remain fixed-size.

Problem:
- Attestors were stored as a growing map inside BridgeMintAttestation
- When multiple validators attest in the same block, the map grows between simulation and execution
- This caused out-of-gas failures even after fee distribution moved to EndBlock
- Fee distribution adds complex failure cases and can get stuck retrying on corrupted data

Changes:
- New store prefix: bridge_mint_attestors/{chain}/{burn_id}/{valoper}
- MsgBridgeAttestMinted writes one fixed-size attestor entry and updates aggregate power
- Bridge fees are burned inline when threshold is reached (no attestor payouts)

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to the v1.9.3 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
